gitCommit.subject: Sort orientation: progress dashboard, ranking after every round, shared photos, the language of sorting (#359)
gitCommit.body:
Sort orientation: progress dashboard, ranking after every round, shared photos, the language of sorting (#359)

* Sort orientation Phase 1: design spec

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Sort orientation spec rev 2: fold adversarial review

Blockers: shared images need a token-authorized photo route (byte route 401s
anonymous viewers — the MUST was theater as written); finalize+complete in one
transaction; round pages guard completed sessions (silent-stranding path);
e2e sweep completed (compare.spec, sort-session.spec, walkthrough, capture.ts).
TONE fixes: accomplished-count framing everywhere (no 'still to sort'),
omit-at-zero for triage too, 'ranking' not 'order', SessionAnalytics keeps its
own heading. PRODUCT amendment gains one flagged clause for the recap door.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* spec: clean editing artifact

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Sort orientation Phase 1: implementation plan

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(share): shared results show item photos via a token-scoped route

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(sort): per-sort progress on the hub and workspace — orientation, gently

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* spec: honest compare-stability contract (new items may legitimately unsettle)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(sort): honest compare-stability contract and pins

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(sort): the ranking is one tap from every round's end

WhatMoved gains a required resultsHref and renders "See your ranking so
far" -> the collection's results page, before "Back to your sort" (spec
§C). All three round hosts (triage/usage/compare) thread it through via
TriageRound/UsageRound/RoundSurface. SeeResultsCard's button label
becomes "See results" — the hub's permanent door (§C.2/§D).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(copy): which would you reach for first — the language of sorting, amended first-order

Owner-signed language sweep (spec §D): the compare round's name/explainer/
subline drop the forced "love more" A/B framing for "which would you reach
for first?"; the results/standing heading becomes "Your ranking so far"
(SessionAnalytics' tier-presence "Where things stand" is untouched — it is
not a ranking). SortHelpDialog's compare description follows. Every unit,
onboarding, and e2e assertion tied to the old strings is updated; the
capture.ts screenshot script's waits follow the new headings.

PRODUCT.md and TONE.md get their owner-approved first-order amendments:
Principle 1 gains the orientation-dashboard exception clause (including the
"quiet door" delta flagged for owner ratification), the anti-references
KPI-dashboard bullet gains its carve-out, Principle 5 gains the
always-show-photo sentence, and every "which do you love more?" becomes
"which would you reach for first?" (PRODUCT.md L21/L43, TONE.md L31).

Post-sweep grep proof: "love more" survives only as a regression-guard
assertion of its absence; "Show me what I love" has zero hits; "Where
things stand" remains only in SessionAnalytics + its test.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(sessions): finalize closes the pass; rounds guard a finished sort

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(sessions): finalize rollback proof; document the session side effect

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs+copy: final-review sweep — matcher enumeration, amended question in governance docs, walkthrough prose anchor

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* graphify: refresh committed graph

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

a11y: unauthenticated login — no serious/critical violations (dark)

gentle progress text appears after a comparison is made

rotate from a card fires a persisted PATCH and announces the result
zoom in changes the image scale
flips to the next photo and shows the details card
the view control opens the zoom/rotate viewer
(1) un-block → purge chain: 409 → remove-from-sorts → purge → gone
(2) finalized dead-end: remove-from-sorts leaves 1 finalized, purge stays 409
(3) authz: a non-owner is 403 on BOTH ops; item + results survive
login page fits the viewport and has tap-sized controls
collections page renders the grid without overflow when authenticated
owner sees both RoleBadges and the email-only InviteForm
Remove is gated to the non-owner row
submitting a valid email shows the announced success
set aside the focused item → it leaves the flow → inline undo + list bring-back both return it

no ceiling: neither triage nor the set-aside list shows an 'of N' total or remaining count
defer the focused item → it leaves the pass → resurfaces last with the patient-waiting skin
no ceiling: progress is affirm-only — never an 'of N' total or remaining count
saving a new display name reflects in the header without a reload
profile links to tutorials and the completed sort tutorial

suites.title: draft result — manual re-rank persists through the bulk endpoint
